point_name_ref: Oiasso extreme end of the Pyrenees
note: Same place as Ocasso promontory of the Pyrenees (2.7.1) -- the Pyrenees own Atlantic end, cited once from Vascones (2.6, Tarraconensis) and once from Aquitania (2.7) as their shared boundary point. Confirmed via the automatic stitch suggestion (0.17 degree gap, essentially identical coordinates).

Cited at 33°30' longitude, 3 degrees west of its own immediate neighbours (mouth of the Tiber river at 36°30', Antium at 36°50') and its own latitude matches the Tiber mouth exactly -- Ostia is the Tiber-mouth port in reality, so it renders 3 degrees out to sea instead of on the coastal walk with its neighbours. Corrected to the Tiber mouth's own longitude (36°30'), putting it back in line with the walk.
